events.title: The Gap
events.description: The Gap erases much of recorded history and marks the beginning of the modern era.
events.citation: Starfinder Player Core, “A Year on Absalom Station” (history overview).

events.title: Triune’s Signal
events.description: Triune’s Signal leads to the discovery of the Drift and Drift travel.
events.citation: Starfinder Player Core, “A Year on Absalom Station” (history overview).

events.title: The Pact Worlds Unite
events.citation: Starfinder Player Core, “A Year on Absalom Station” (history overview).

events.title: Aucturn Hatches
events.description: Aucturn hatches, birthing the outer godling called the Newborn and forming the Gelid Edge at the Pact Worlds’ fringes.
events.citation: Starfinder Player Core, “A Year on Absalom Station” (history overview).
